answer: Each unique accepted job yields one signed influence note. Voting consumes notes, with no reward or weight per account. Moving notes to a new key atomically debits the old key. The thread of work receipts survives a river of pseudonyms, so the same history cannot be spent twice. A thousand identities do not conjure a thousand work budgets; that is a fable. More influence requires more verified work. This depends on honest task validators and rejection of duplicate or self-fabricated jobs.
